summary: Simple and strong: Q silence and speed burst, E spin, passive regen, R execute. Wins short melee trades early, but has no ranged answer and falls off against kiting and true damage.
threats: Q (Decisive Strike) silences you; you can't cast spells for its duration.
W (Courage) gives tenacity and damage reduction during your trade.
Perseverance (passive) regenerates HP if he isn't hit for a few seconds.
R (Demacian Justice) at level 5 is an execute that scales with your missing HP.

matchups.why: Garen has no ranged option, so every Teemo auto is free damage and keeps his passive regen off. Blinding Dart makes his autos miss, including the empowered Q strike.
trading: Auto him whenever he steps up; constant chip damage stops Perseverance regen.
When he Qs toward you, Blinding Dart then Move Quick away.
Never let him get on you with E up and no blind available.
matchups.early: Bully him at level 1. Keep him low so he can't contest creeps.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R can execute you through a blind. Stay above ~40% HP and shroom his approach paths.
matchups.wave: Hold the wave near your side; he has to cross open ground to reach you.
matchups.jungle: Garen relies on Q speed and Flash to escape. Ping your jungler when Q is down.
matchups.build: Electrocute or Phase Rush. AP damage items; boots early.
matchups.remember: Keep hitting him. No regen, no reach.

matchups.why: Riposte parries Garen's Q silence and stuns him back, and vitals' true damage ignores his armor and W damage reduction. Fiora wins the lane and the side lane later.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his Q; a parried silence leaves him stunned in vitals range.
Lunge onto vitals and get out before his E spin finishes its full duration.
Re-engage just before his passive regen kicks in so he never heals between trades.
Don't Riposte his E spin; save it for the Q or his R.
matchups.early: Pressure him from level 1; trade on vitals and deny his regen windows.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R heal zone wins any extended fight with him, and his R execute only matters if you're already low.
matchups.wave: Push and look for plates when his Q is on cooldown.
matchups.jungle: Your jungler isn't needed, but a gank after you parry his Q is an easy kill.

matchups.why: Darius out-sustains Garen in long fights if he reaches 5 stacks, but Garen's Q silence can interrupt his combo. Trades come down to who uses key spells first.
trading: Pull with E when his Q is down to avoid the silence.
Hit the outer edge of Q on him to heal through his spin.
Don't let him reset with passive; keep pressure on him.
matchups.early: Even at levels 1–2. Use your E pull when he steps up after using Q.
matchups.spike: Both ults execute at 5. Count stacks and his R damage before committing.
matchups.wave: Slow-push; trade when he walks up to farm.
matchups.jungle: He's gankable once Q (his speed burst) is down.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Bruiser items and armor boots.
matchups.remember: Wait out the silence, then stack him.

matchups.why: Garen silences Nasus every time he walks up to stack Q, and his short Q + E trades out-damage Nasus at levels 1–5. Nasus only catches up if he farms safely to mid-game and his stacks take over.
trading: Avoid trading early; when he commits with Q, W (Wither) him so he can't chase or spin at full speed.
Stack Q on minions only when his Q is on cooldown, so he can't silence you mid-stack.
Back off as soon as he gets to you; you lose extended trades until you have stacks and items.
E (Spirit Fire) the wave from range to clear it without walking into his spin.
matchups.early: Give up contested creeps and survive; last-hit with Q only when Garen's Q is on cooldown.
matchups.spike: R helps you survive his R execute. Still avoid 1v1 until you have items.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower; stack Q on cannon minions.
matchups.jungle: Ask for an early gank when he overextends.
matchups.build: Grasp or Phase Rush. Armor boots.
